name: Jeshua
overview: Jeshua was a male member of the tribe of Levi known for his role in distributing portions to his brothers, reflecting a responsibility within the Levitical community. His service is noted specifically in 2 Chronicles 31:15. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide additional details about his life or ministry.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeshua means 'YHWH saves,' highlighting a theologically rich meaning connected to God's saving work. This proper name is recorded in 2 Chronicles 31:15 and is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Jeshua as a son of Levi, indicating his Levitical lineage. No other family relationships are recorded beyond this connection in 2 Chronicles 31:15.
scriptureSignificance: Jeshua's significance lies in his practical service within the Levitical community, particularly in the distribution of portions to his brothers. This role underscores the organized stewardship and support among the Levites during the time recorded in 2 Chronicles. His mention, though brief, contributes to the biblical record of faithful service to God's appointed order.
